correctness.rationale: The proof exhausts the \(\Omega(n)=2\) factorization shapes. Prime squares and even semiprimes are excluded directly. For odd \(pq\), exact algebra reduces the problem to \(uv\mid(u+v)(u+v+1)\), then coprimality gives precisely \(g\mid a+b\) and \(ab\mid g(a+b)+1\). The factor identity and its converse are obtained by expansion, and the bounds on \(h\) and \(q\) are proved symbolically. Finite verification is not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The semiprime stratum is the first nontrivial composite multiplicative layer of the exact A097605/A098271 divisibility set. The result replaces table lookup by an exact finite divisor-pair generator in every gcd stratum and yields the uniform bound \(q\le(p^2+1)/2\). These are structural, reusable constraints rather than a bounded census.
